summary: Clover Health filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a cybersecurity incident involving anomalous login activity on July 4, 2026. A threat actor gained access to three non-managerial health plan employee accounts through social engineering. The accounts had access to certain personally identifiable and protected health information but not corporate financial or claims systems. The company activated response procedures, engaged third-party experts, notified law enforcement, and believes the unauthorized access was contained. The company does not expect the incident to have a material impact on its business, financial condition, or results. No merger, acquisition, or special-situation transaction is involved.
